findings.summary: Connections route never renders the channel policy control plane UI.
findings.details: The task requires admins to bulk-select joined channels and set policies on the Connections surface. The route adds a channelPolicy fixture, but the ready-state screen type excludes it and the screen renders only the existing connections table; the new ChannelTable and ChannelPolicyDialogSummary components are unused. This makes the focused view-model tests a false green for the UI requirement.

findings.summary: Bulk policy mutation discards audit rows instead of writing a durable audit record.
findings.details: The pure planner returns auditRows, but the Confect mutation inserts only routing and delivery policy rows. Returning auditAction is not durable observability and does not satisfy the all-or-nothing audited bulk-change requirement.
